ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of hands that won't come clean

plain.li: Dreamt I was washing my hands at the well and the water kept coming up grey, no matter how long I scrubbed.
In the dream the food on every plate had gone bad, and everyone kept eating it, and smiling at me to do the same.
Dreamt the whole colony smelled of something rotten, and nobody else could smell it.

blunt.li: Dreamt of filth. Everywhere. Woke up and washed twice.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I couldn't get clean. I'm still not sure I am.

cold.li: A dream of contamination. My stomach believed it. My mind did not.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of an empty chair

plain.li: Dreamt {LOST} was at supper in the usual chair, passing the salt, and nobody thought it strange but me.
In the dream I kept setting a place for {LOST}, and every time I turned round the plate was empty, as if it had been eaten.
Dreamt I heard {LOST} laughing in the next room. I didn't open the door. I didn't want to know.
[child] I dreamt {LOST} came to say goodnight like always. Then I woke up and remembered.

warm.li: Dreamt {LOST} told me it was all right to be happy again. I'm trying to believe the dream.

blunt.li: Dreamt of {LOST}. Woke up. {LOST}'s still gone.

gloomy.li: Every night the same: {LOST}, alive, and then morning.

cold.li: {LOST} appeared in a dream. Grief has its own logic. I am learning it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a hand to hold

plain.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I were walking somewhere with no name, and neither of us wanted to arrive.
In my dream {OTHER_nameDef} said my name the way you say a word you like the sound of.
Dreamt I was cold, and then {OTHER_nameDef} was there, and I wasn't.

warm.li: Dreamt of {OTHER_nameDef}, just sitting beside me. That was the whole dream. It was enough.

blunt.li: Dreamt about {OTHER_nameDef}. Not telling you the rest.

cheerful.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I danced at a feast, and I didn't step on anyone's feet!

gloomy.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} loved me back. Woke up afraid to find out.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a summer that wouldn't end

plain.li: Dreamt it was the longest day of summer and the sun simply didn't set, and nobody minded.
In the dream everyone I've ever loved was at one long table, laughing at the same joke.
[child] I dreamt I could run so fast my feet left the ground and I didn't come down until supper.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I was laughing so hard I woke myself up. Still laughing. No idea what at.

warm.li: A dream with nothing wrong in it at all. I've been carrying it round all morning.

blunt.li: Good dream. Woke up happy. That's it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of something vast

plain.li: Dreamt I stood at the edge of the world and looked down, and there were stars below me as well as above.
In the dream a creature walked past the colony that was taller than the hills, and it was gentle, and it didn't see us.
Dreamt the sky opened like a door, and behind it was more sky, brighter.

warm.li: Dreamt of something so big and beautiful I cried in the dream. Woke up with wet cheeks.

cold.li: A dream of scale beyond comprehension. I woke unusually calm.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of something vast that didn't care whether we lived. Strangely comforting.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the road back

plain.li: Dreamt I found the road back to where I grew up, and every step of it was exactly as I remembered.
In the dream I opened a door in the colony and it led straight into my mother's kitchen.
[child] I dreamt about my old bed, and the crack in the ceiling shaped like a fish.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of home. The real one. Woke up here, which is a home too, I suppose.

warm.li: Dreamt of the people I left behind. They were well. I hope it's true.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of work undone

plain.li: Dreamt I built a wall all day and every time I looked back the first stones had walked off.
In the dream I had to finish a job before morning, and every tool I picked up turned into a spoon.
Dreamt I was explaining something simple to the council and they kept nodding and doing the opposite.

blunt.li: Dreamt about work going wrong. Woke up. Work's still going wrong.

cheerful.li: Dreamt my tools turned into spoons! Very frustrating. Also very funny, now I'm awake.

cold.li: A dream of futile labor. My waking hours have prepared me well.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of an ordinary day

plain.li: Dreamt of an ordinary day here: bread, work, a bit of sun, supper. I woke up and it was that day.
In the dream I sat on the step and watched the colony go about its business, and I didn't have to do anything.
[child] I dreamt about our house with all of us in it, and nothing happened, and it was nice.

warm.li: Dreamt of nothing much, among people I love. The best kind of dream.

cold.li: A dream of routine. Unremarkable, and therefore pleasant.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of a quiet day. I'll take the real one too, if it comes.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the storm coming

plain.li: Dreamt the storm came over the hills like a wall, and I was the only one who saw it, and nobody would listen.
In the dream the thunder had a voice, and it knew my name.
[rain|storm] Dreamt the rain on the roof was footsteps. Woke up. It's only rain. It's only rain.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the storm again. Every time it's closer.

cold.li: The storm nightmare again. I know it isn't real. My heart doesn't.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the lamp going out

plain.li: Dreamt the lamp went out and the dark came in like water, filling the room from the floor up.
In the dream something stood in the corner where the light didn't reach, and waited, and waited.
[child] I dreamt my light went out and I couldn't find it, and then I woke up and it was still on.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the dark again. I always do, when I forget the light.

blunt.li: Dark dream. Lit the lamp. Went back to sleep.

cold.li: The usual nightmare of darkness. The lamp was burning when I woke. Noted.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a lamp in the window

plain.li: Dreamt my little light grew and grew until the whole colony glowed, and nobody was ever afraid again.
[child] I dreamt my candle could talk, and it said it would stay awake so I didn't have to.

warm.li: Dreamt of a lamp in a window, waiting for me to come home. I knew whose window it was.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I carried my light out into the dark and the dark ran away!

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of walking among the stars

plain.li: Dreamt I climbed the tallest tree and kept climbing until I was among the stars, and they were warm, like coals.
In the dream the stars rearranged themselves into a map, and I almost understood where it led.
Dreamt I named a new star, and in the morning it was still there.

warm.li: Dreamt I showed everyone the stars, and for once they all looked up at the same time.

cold.li: A dream of navigation by unfamiliar constellations. I memorized one. It may be real.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the plants answering

plain.li: Dreamt the plants finally answered me. They had a lot of opinions about the watering.
In the dream the whole field turned to look at me as I passed, like a crowd at a feast.
Dreamt the seedlings told me which of them would make it. I didn't like the answer, so I woke up.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the potatoes thanked me personally. Lovely manners, potatoes.

cold.li: A dream in which the crops communicated. Their complaints were reasonable.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a list that never ends

plain.li: Dreamt I was checking the bolts on the gate, and every time I finished, there was another gate.
In the dream I counted everyone at supper and came up one short, and counted again, and again.
Dreamt of a list of everything that could go wrong. It went down to the floor and out of the door.

gloomy.li: The list dream. The list is always longer.

blunt.li: Worry dream. Got up and checked the door. It was locked.

cold.li: A dream enumerating contingencies. It was thorough. I am tired.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of every stray at once

plain.li: Dreamt every stray animal I ever fed came to the gate at once, a whole parade of them, and every one remembered me.
In the dream I had a name for every creature in the world, and they all came when called.
[child] I dreamt my hurt bird got better and brought all its friends to say thank you.

warm.li: Dreamt there wasn't a hungry animal anywhere. I could have stayed in that dream forever.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I was followed home by forty cats! The cook was not pleased.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the old sayings

plain.li: Dreamt my grandmother sat at the end of my bed and told me a saying I'd never heard, and I've forgotten it, and I want it back.
In the dream every story I ever told was a person, and they all came to visit at once.
Dreamt I told a story that didn't end, and the children grew up listening to it.

warm.li: Dreamt all my old stories were sitting round a fire, telling each other. I just listened.

cold.li: A dream composed entirely of proverbs. Several contradicted each other.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a wedding

plain.li: Dreamt of a wedding by the fields, with flowers in everyone's hair. I couldn't see who I was marrying, but I knew I was happy.
In the dream someone saved me a seat by the fire, every night, and never once asked for anything back.
Dreamt I was loved, simply and completely, and woke up wanting it so much it hurt.

warm.li: Dreamt of growing old beside someone. Didn't see their face. Felt their hand.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of love. Woke up alone. Still want to {GOAL}.

cheerful.li: Dreamt of my wedding! The food was excellent. I'll tell the cook.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the far road

plain.li: Dreamt I walked over the hills and there was a sea on the other side, and a town, and a road going on.
In the dream I had a pack on my back and nowhere to be until next spring.
Dreamt the road went on past everything I know, and I just kept walking.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I saw the whole world in a week! My feet are tired just thinking about it.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the road. Woke up behind the same walls.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of an animal of one's own

plain.li: Dreamt a wild animal walked out of the trees and lay down at my feet, as if it had been waiting for me.
[child] I dreamt I had a dog as big as a horse and I rode it to the river and back.
Dreamt I knew the name every animal in the colony calls itself, and they all came to me.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I had a pet that could talk! It mostly talked about food.

warm.li: Dreamt of an animal that trusted me completely. Woke up wanting to earn it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the last thing made

plain.li: Dreamt I was making the finest thing I've ever made, and my hands knew what to do before I did.
In the dream the piece I'm working on was finished and standing in the hall, and people stopped to touch it as they passed.
Dreamt my teacher stood behind me at the bench and said nothing, which was the highest praise there was.

warm.li: Dreamt the thing I made was being used, years from now, by someone I'll never meet.

cold.li: A dream of the work completed. I noted the method. It may help.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the walls holding

plain.li: Dreamt the raiders came and the walls simply held, and they went away, and we finished supper.
In the dream I slept with the door open and nothing came through it but morning.
Dreamt I wasn't afraid. Just that. Woke up and remembered what it felt like.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I felt safe. Woke up and checked the bolts anyway.

warm.li: Dreamt everyone I care about was asleep and safe, and I was keeping watch, and it was easy.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the little ones grown

plain.li: Dreamt the children were grown and running the colony, and doing it better than we ever did.
In the dream a grown stranger hugged me at the gate, and I realized it was one of the little ones, years from now.
[child] I dreamt I was a grown-up and everyone listened to me and I was allowed to stay up as late as I liked.

warm.li: Dreamt of the young ones grown, and kind. That's all I want from the years left.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of them grown. I wasn't there. I'd like to be.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of two doors

plain.li: Dreamt of two doors, and {OTHER_nameDef} behind one of them, and I couldn't choose, and then the doors chose for me.
In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} was speaking, but I couldn't hear the words over my own heart.
Dreamt I was racing someone across the fields and neither of us knew where the finish was.

gloomy.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} looked straight through me, at someone behind me.

cheerful.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} picked a flower and handed it to me! Or past me. Hard to tell in dreams.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a rope pulled both ways

plain.li: Dreamt I was the knot in the middle of a rope, and two people I love were pulling on each end.
In the dream I carried a message back and forth across a river all night, and it changed a little every time.
Dreamt everyone I'm caught between was sitting at one table, eating in silence, passing everything through me.

warm.li: Dreamt the rope went slack, and the two ends came together, and I could put it down.

blunt.li: Dreamt I was stuck in the middle. Am stuck in the middle. Thanks, sleep.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of one more spring

plain.li: Dreamt the snow went off the fields in a single morning, and everything came up green at once, and I was there to see it.
In the dream I was young, and sitting in the sun outside the first house we built, and {OTHER_nameDef} was young too.
Dreamt of a spring that went on and on, and I wasn't tired at all.

warm.li: Dreamt of spring, and everyone I love out in the fields. I'd like one more of those.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of spring. Woke up to winter. There's still time.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a letter from far away

plain.li: Dreamt a letter came, in a hand I knew, and I opened it and every page was blank, and I read it anyway.
In the dream I could see across all the miles at once, and everyone out there was going about their day, all right.
Dreamt a traveler came to the gate with news, and I woke up just before the news.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of a letter with bad news in it. I couldn't read the words. I knew what they said.

warm.li: Dreamt of a letter that said: we're well, don't worry. I'm keeping that one.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of flying

plain.li: Dreamt I could fly, and the dark was just the sky with the sun turned down, and I wasn't scared of it at all.
[child] I dreamt I flew over the colony and everyone waved, and {OTHER_nameDef} waved the biggest.
Dreamt I was bigger than the trouble. It was very small, from up there.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I could fly! I'm going to try again tonight.

warm.li: Dreamt I flew home, and someone had left the light on for me.
